title: paspalum setaceum var. ciliatifolium
intro: Paspalum setaceum var. ciliatifolium, commonly known as the "feather plume grass", is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Paspalum setaceum var. ciliatifolium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant are flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
